users_locale_check.name: users_locale_check
users_locale_check.value: locale is null or locale in ('en', 'es', 'fr', 'de', 'it', 'pt', 'nl', 'ru', 'ar', 'hi', 'ja', 'zh-CN', 'zh-TW')

bulk_operations_counts_check.name: bulk_operations_counts_check
bulk_operations_counts_check.value: processed <= total and succeeded + failed <= processed

signup_codes_uses_check.name: signup_codes_uses_check
signup_codes_uses_check.value: uses >= 0 and uses <= max_uses and max_uses between 1 and 1000

credit_ledger_draft_kind_check.name: credit_ledger_draft_kind_check
credit_ledger_draft_kind_check.value: draft_kind is null or draft_kind in ('tagline', 'description', 'faq')

credit_ledger_sign_check.name: credit_ledger_sign_check
credit_ledger_sign_check.value: (kind = 'debit' and amount < 0) or (kind in ('grant', 'refund') and amount > 0) or kind = 'adjust'

checkpoints_location_check.name: checkpoints_location_check
checkpoints_location_check.value: (latitude is null) = (longitude is null) and (latitude is null or (latitude between -90 and 90 and longitude between -180 and 180))

devices_battery_check.name: devices_battery_check
devices_battery_check.value: battery_pct is null or battery_pct between 0 and 100

events_category_check.name: events_category_check
events_category_check.value: category is null or category in ('arts_culture', 'business_seminars', 'charity', 'community', 'education_classes', 'family', 'food_drink', 'health_wellness', 'music', 'nightlife', 'religion_spirituality', 'social_gatherings', 'sports_fitness', 'technology', 'travel_leisure', 'other')

public_listings_price_check.name: public_listings_price_check
public_listings_price_check.value: min_price_minor is null or min_price_minor <= max_price_minor

assets_owner_slot_check.name: assets_owner_slot_check
assets_owner_slot_check.value: (owner_type = 'event' and slot in ('cover', 'gallery')) or (owner_type = 'venue' and slot = 'photo') or (owner_type = 'org' and slot = 'logo' and owner_id = org_id)

assets_alt_check.name: assets_alt_check
assets_alt_check.value: decorative or (alt is not null and length(btrim(alt)) between 1 and 300)

reports_review_check.name: reports_review_check
reports_review_check.value: (status = 'open' and reviewed_at is null) or (status <> 'open' and reviewed_at is not null and reviewed_by is not null and review_note is not null)

reports_review_note_length.name: reports_review_note_length
reports_review_note_length.value: review_note is null or length(review_note) between 1 and 1000

thread_messages_content_check.name: thread_messages_content_check
thread_messages_content_check.value: (body is not null and length(body) between 1 and 5000) or announcement_id is not null

address_suppressions_address_check.name: address_suppressions_address_check
address_suppressions_address_check.value: (channel = 'email' and address_norm = lower(btrim(address_norm)) and address_norm like '%@%') or (channel = 'sms' and address_norm ~ '^\+[0-9]{6,15}$')

message_events_bounce_type_check.name: message_events_bounce_type_check
message_events_bounce_type_check.value: (type = 'bounced' and bounce_type in ('hard', 'soft')) or (type <> 'bounced' and bounce_type is null)

messages_org_event_queued_idx.name: messages_org_event_queued_idx
messages_org_event_queued_idx.where: status = 'queued' and event_id is not null

messages_delivery_check.name: messages_delivery_check
messages_delivery_check.value: delivery is null or delivery in ('delivered', 'bounced', 'soft_bounced', 'complained')

messages_address_check.name: messages_address_check
messages_address_check.value: (channel = 'email' and (recipient_email is not null or recipient_user_id is not null)) or (channel = 'push' and recipient_user_id is not null) or channel = 'sms'

template_overrides_subject_length.name: template_overrides_subject_length
template_overrides_subject_length.value: subject is null or length(subject) between 1 and 200

template_overrides_intro_length.name: template_overrides_intro_length
template_overrides_intro_length.value: intro is null or length(intro) between 1 and 2000

orders_totals_check.name: orders_totals_check
orders_totals_check.value: subtotal_minor >= 0 and fee_minor >= 0 and total_minor = subtotal_minor + fee_minor

orders_payment_method_check.name: orders_payment_method_check
orders_payment_method_check.value: payment_method is null or payment_method in ('cash', 'zelle', 'card_terminal', 'other')

orders_charge_model_check.name: orders_charge_model_check
orders_charge_model_check.value: charge_model is null or charge_model in ('legacy_platform', 'legacy_direct_connected', 'legacy_destination', 'paypal', 'offline', 'sct')

refund_policies_days_check.name: refund_policies_days_check
refund_policies_days_check.value: (kind = 'until') = (days_before is not null) and (days_before is null or days_before between 0 and 365)

refunds_amount_check.name: refunds_amount_check
refunds_amount_check.value: amount_minor > 0 and fee_refunded_minor between 0 and amount_minor

legacy_settlements_amounts_check.name: legacy_settlements_amounts_check
legacy_settlements_amounts_check.value: customer_paid_minor >= 0 and commission_minor >= 0 and admin_tax_minor >= 0 and organizer_earning_minor >= 0 and transferred_minor >= 0 and open_minor >= 0 and clawback_minor >= 0 and source_rows >= 0

reconciliation_items_resolved_check.name: reconciliation_items_resolved_check
reconciliation_items_resolved_check.value: (status = 'open') = (resolved_at is null) and (status = 'open' or length(resolution_note) between 3 and 500)

settlements_amounts_check.name: settlements_amounts_check
settlements_amounts_check.value: released_minor >= 0 and reserve_minor >= 0 and netted_minor >= 0 and amount_minor >= 0 and amount_minor = released_minor - reserve_minor - netted_minor

event_seats_block_check.name: event_seats_block_check
event_seats_block_check.value: (status = 'blocked') = (block_reason is not null) and (block_reason is null or block_reason in ('channel', 'ada', 'kill', 'assigned', 'group'))

event_seats_hold_check.name: event_seats_hold_check
event_seats_hold_check.value: (status = 'held') = (hold_id is not null and hold_expires_at is not null)

event_seats_group_check.name: event_seats_group_check
event_seats_group_check.value: (block_reason is distinct from 'group' or group_label is not null) and (group_label is null or length(group_label) between 1 and 40)

seat_assignments_prior_block_check.name: seat_assignments_prior_block_check
seat_assignments_prior_block_check.value: prior_block is null or prior_block in ('channel', 'ada', 'group')

invitations_org_email_pending_key.name: invitations_org_email_pending_key
invitations_org_email_pending_key.where: accepted_at is null and revoked_at is null

org_domains_hostname_check.name: org_domains_hostname_check
org_domains_hostname_check.value: hostname = lower(hostname) and length(hostname) between 4 and 253 and hostname ~ '^[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?([.][a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9])?)+$'

organizations_logo_check.name: organizations_logo_check
organizations_logo_check.value: (logo_path is null and logo_alt is null) or (logo_path ~ '^/media/[0-9a-f-]{36}/[0-9a-f-]{36}/[0-9]{1,5}-[0-9a-f]{32}[.](png|jpg)$' and length(btrim(logo_alt)) between 1 and 300)

promo_codes_value_check.name: promo_codes_value_check
promo_codes_value_check.value: (kind = 'percent' and percent_bps between 1 and 10000 and amount_minor is null) or (kind = 'amount' and amount_minor > 0 and percent_bps is null)

promo_codes_redemptions_check.name: promo_codes_redemptions_check
promo_codes_redemptions_check.value: redeemed_count >= 0 and (max_redemptions is null or (max_redemptions >= 1 and redeemed_count <= max_redemptions))

promo_codes_window_check.name: promo_codes_window_check
promo_codes_window_check.value: ends_at is null or starts_at is null or ends_at > starts_at

ticket_claims_org_ticket_open_key.name: ticket_claims_org_ticket_open_key
ticket_claims_org_ticket_open_key.where: claimed_at is null and revoked_at is null

ticket_types_inventory_check.name: ticket_types_inventory_check
ticket_types_inventory_check.value: quantity_sold >= 0 and quantity_held >= 0 and quantity_sold + quantity_held <= quantity_total

ticket_types_window_check.name: ticket_types_window_check
ticket_types_window_check.value: sales_end_at is null or sales_start_at is null or sales_end_at > sales_start_at

ticket_types_early_check.name: ticket_types_early_check
ticket_types_early_check.value: (early_price_minor is null) = (early_ends_at is null) and (early_price_minor is null or (early_price_minor >= 0 and early_price_minor < price_minor))

ticket_types_donation_check.name: ticket_types_donation_check
ticket_types_donation_check.value: not is_donation or early_price_minor is null

venues_geo_check.name: venues_geo_check
venues_geo_check.value: (latitude is null) = (longitude is null) and (latitude is null or (latitude between -90 and 90 and longitude between -180 and 180))
